```{r, echo=TRUE}
## ==========================================================
## TFCE analysis in R for exported within-subject EEG CSV
##
## Input files:
##   ../data/05_designTable.csv
##   ../data/05_EEGdata_long.csv
##
## Model:
##   Amplitude ~ CondCode + (1|Subject)
##
## Permutation:
##   Rearrange condition labels within each subject
##   EEG data itself is never permuted
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(future)
library(future.apply)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(progressr)
library(fields)

source("../R/tfce_transform.R")

cat("\nStarting TFCE within-subject analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load CSV files
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read.csv("../data/05_designTable.csv")
EEGlong     <- read.csv("../data/05_EEGdata_long.csv")

print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Merge EEG data with design table
## ==========================================================

designTable <- designTable %>%
  mutate(RowID = row_number())

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(designTable, by = c("Subject", "CondCode")) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject = factor(Subject),
    Channel = factor(Channel),
    CondCode = as.numeric(CondCode)
  )

channels <- unique(dat$Channel)
times    <- sort(unique(dat$Time))

nChan <- length(channels)
nTime <- length(times)

## ==========================================================
## -2. Function to compute LME t-map
## ==========================================================

compute_tmap <- function(data) {
  res <- data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      fit <- lmer(Amplitude ~ CondCode + (1 | Subject), data = .x)
      tibble(t_value = coef(summary(fit))["CondCode", "t value"])
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  tmat <- res %>%
    mutate(
      Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
      Time = factor(Time, levels = times)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Channel, Time) %>%
    pull(t_value)
  
  matrix(
    tmat,
    nrow = nChan,
    ncol = nTime,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(channels, times)
  )
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed t-map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-map...\n")

t_Obs <- compute_tmap(dat)

cat("Observed t-map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Observed TFCE map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE map...\n")

TFCE_Obs <- tfce_transform(t_Obs, E  = 0.66, H  = 2, dh = 0.1)

cat("Observed TFCE map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 3: Permutation distribution
## ==========================================================

set.seed(123)

n_perm <- 999

TFCE_permMax <- rep(NaN, n_perm)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3.1. Prepare the observed long-format dataset once
## ------------------------------------------------------------
subject_info <- designTable %>%
  select(RowID, Subject, CondCode)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3.2. Set up parallel processing
## ------------------------------------------------------------

n_workers <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)

plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

handlers("txtprogressbar")

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3.3 Parallel permutation test
## ------------------------------------------------------------

with_progress({
  progress_update <- progressor(along = seq_len(n_perm))
  
  TFCE_permMax <- future_sapply(seq_len(n_perm), function(p) {
    perm_info <- subject_info %>%
      group_by(Subject) %>%
      mutate(CondCode = sample(CondCode)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    perm_dat <- EEGlong %>%
      left_join(perm_info, by = c("Subject", "CondCode")) %>%
      mutate(
        Subject = factor(Subject),
        Channel = factor(Channel),
        CondCode = as.numeric(CondCode)
      )
    t_perm <- compute_tmap(perm_dat)
    
    TFCE_perm <- tfce_transform(t_perm,
                                E = 0.66,
                                H = 2,
                                dh = 0.1)
    
    perm_max <- max(abs(TFCE_perm), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    progress_update()
    perm_max
    
  },
  future.seed = TRUE,
  future.packages = c("dplyr",
                      "tidyr",
                      "lme4",
                      "lmerTest"))
})

plan(sequential)

## ==========================================================
## Step 4: TFCE-corrected significance
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 4: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")

alpha <- 0.05

maxTFCE <- sort(c(TFCE_permMax, max(abs(TFCE_Obs), na.rm = TRUE)))
maxTFCEcrit <- maxTFCE[round(n_perm * (1 - alpha))]

Mask <- abs(TFCE_Obs) >= maxTFCEcrit

P_Values <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(TFCE_Obs),
  ncol = ncol(TFCE_Obs),
  dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_Obs)
)

for (ch in seq_len(nChan)) {
  for (t in seq_len(nTime)) {
    P_Values[ch, t] <-
      (sum(TFCE_permMax >= abs(TFCE_Obs[ch, t]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
      (n_perm + 1)
  }
}

cat("TFCE-corrected significance completed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE value = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcrit))

## ==========================================================
## Step 5: Store results
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 5: Storing results...\n")

Results <- list(
  tObs         = t_Obs,
  TFCE_Obs     = TFCE_Obs,
  TFCE_Null    = TFCE_permMax,
  maxTFCEcrit  = maxTFCEcrit,
  P_Values     = P_Values,
  Mask         = Mask,
  alpha        = alpha,
  n_perm        = n_perm,
  model        = "Amplitude ~ GroupCode + (1|Subject)",
  permutation  = "Within-subject permutation"
)

cat("Results stored.\n")


## ==========================================================
## Step 6: Save TFCE results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../Results")) {
  dir.create("../Results")
}

save(Results, times, nChan, channels, file = "../Results/05_TFCE_within_subject_results.RData")


cat("TFCE within-subject analysis completed and results saved.\n")

```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
rm(list =ls())
source("../R/plot_eeg_map.R")
load("../Results/05_TFCE_within_subject_results.RData")
## ==========================================================
## Step 7: Plot TFCE-corrected significant t-values
## ==========================================================

mT <- Results$tObs
mT[!Results$Mask] <- 0

plot_eeg_map(mT,
             "TFCE-corrected Group Effect Adjusted for Covariate",
             times,
             nChan,
             channels)

plot_eeg_map(
  Results$TFCE_Obs,
  "Observed TFCE Map: Group Effect Adjusted for Covariate",
  times,
  nChan,
  channels
)

```
